entries.name: Water shutoff
entries.warning: Lantern Market · the city’s debt-collection system is shutting off the kitchen water. Repair both marked controls and defeat its machines.
entries.success: The kitchen has running water again. Neighbors can return for a meal.
entries.failure: The kitchen water is off. Wait nearby for the controls to reset, then try again.

entries.name: Memory cooling failure
entries.warning: Glass Steps · the cooling pipes have burst. Repair both marked controls. Move out of striped danger areas before the countdown ends.
entries.success: Cooling works again. Residents can put the rescued memory records back into safe storage.
entries.failure: Cooling has stopped. Residents move the memory records to safety. Wait for the controls to reset, then try again.

entries.name: Heating shutdown
entries.warning: Copper Walk · debt collectors are shutting off heating in occupied homes. Repair both marked controls and defeat their machines.
entries.success: The homes have heating again. The repair crew can take a break and eat.
entries.failure: The collectors have shut off the heating. Wait for the controls to reset, then try again.

entries.name: Flood alarm failure
entries.warning: Listening Courts · floodwater has damaged the warning system. Repair both marked controls. Move out of striped danger areas before the countdown ends.
entries.success: The warning lights and vibrating handrails work again. Neighbors can tend their plants while watching the water level.
entries.failure: The warning system has stopped. Neighbors warn each other door to door. Wait for the controls to reset, then try again.

entries.name: Night lift shutdown
entries.warning: Last Connection · the lift system is rejecting night workers’ passes. Repair both marked controls and defeat the machines blocking access.
entries.success: The lift accepts passes again. The stranded workers can get home.
entries.failure: The lift still rejects the workers’ passes. Wait for the controls to reset, then try again.
